panels.title: Active Agents
panels.description: Current connected agents or active streams. These are live gauges, so they change during reconnects; historical samples remain in Prometheus.

panels.title: Active Streams
panels.description: Current connected agents or active streams. These are live gauges, so they change during reconnects; historical samples remain in Prometheus.

panels.title: Rejection Rate
panels.description: Client traffic rejections per second, separate from authentication attempts on the agent port.

panels.title: Streams in selected range
panels.description: Streams opened within the selected time range, estimated from stored Prometheus samples. Accounts for observed process counter resets; limited by Prometheus retention. This is not a lifetime total.

panels.title: Active Streams per Customer
panels.description: Current connected agents or active streams. These are live gauges, so they change during reconnects; historical samples remain in Prometheus.

panels.title: Agent Connections per Customer
panels.description: Current connected agents or active streams. These are live gauges, so they change during reconnects; historical samples remain in Prometheus.

options.content: Verified certificates, rejected credentials, protocol probes, incomplete handshakes and capacity rejections are separate. A **probe is not proof of a bot**. Admission metrics require the enterprise relay upgrade; Coverage shows how much of the selection is instrumented.

panels.title: Relay up
panels.description: 1 means Prometheus can scrape the selected relay. No data is unknown, never a healthy zero.

panels.title: Pending
panels.description: Worst selected relay. Applies only before authentication. Missing means the relay has not exported admission metrics.

panels.title: Verified
panels.description: Counter increase over the selected time range, estimated between scrapes. This does not count existing connections or prove intent.

panels.title: Cert rejected
panels.description: Counter increase over the selected time range, estimated between scrapes. This does not count existing connections or prove intent.

panels.title: Probes
panels.description: Counter increase over the selected time range, estimated between scrapes. This does not count existing connections or prove intent.

panels.title: Incomplete
panels.description: Counter increase over the selected time range, estimated between scrapes. This does not count existing connections or prove intent.

panels.title: Pending / limit
panels.description: Authenticated tunnels are excluded from both occupancy and admission checks.

panels.title: Admission capacity rejections
panels.description: New sockets closed because every pending slot is occupied. Does not disconnect established tunnels; reconnects may retry during saturation.

options.content: Search canonical audit events once per attempt. Certificate events are separate from probes and incomplete handshakes. IP addresses and identities are queryable fields, not indexed labels. **Historical auth.failure** has its own view because old records cannot reliably identify probes. No data may mean log ingestion is unavailable; check audit drops above.

panels.title: Certificate authentication events
panels.description: Trusted customer_id is populated only after successful certificate and identity validation. A verified certificate is not evidence of a particular human operator.

panels.title: Historical auth.failure without classification
panels.description: Do not interpret these old entries as confirmed agent failures or bots. Their handshake warning may provide context.

panels.title: Blocked
panels.description: New sockets rejected before TLS. Established tunnels are never evicted.

panels.title: Audit drops
panels.description: Audit enqueue timeout, cancellation, or emitter failure. Nonzero means searchable log evidence may be incomplete; handshake outcome counters still include these attempts.

panels.title: Coverage
panels.description: Fraction of selected relay targets exporting the new admission metrics. Below 100% means admission panels cover only part of the selection. No data means the target set is unknown.
